_note: Qualitative gap library for funnel-leak diagnosis. Heuristic content — the demo can detect WHERE the leak is from data, but only a human (v1) or the production inspection agent can confirm these. Each item carries its detection source: data (computed), inspection (needs an agent to look), input (needs the merchant).

checklist.detail: Shipping revealed late or priced high with no free-shipping threshold in sight. The #1 cart killer in Egypt.
Single-item carts with nothing nudging a second item — no bundle discount, no 'complete the look'.
No clear exchange/return promise near the buy button. Shoppers won't risk it without one.
Missing the payment method they wanted — installments, wallet, or clear cash-on-delivery terms.
The ad promised one price or deal, the cart shows another. Check the top ad sets' landing message against the cart.

add_to_cart_to_checkout.fix_cause: Fix the top-scoring item above, then re-measure this step for 7 days.
add_to_cart_to_checkout.label: Add to cart → Checkout
add_to_cart_to_checkout.likely_meaning: Intent was there, then cold feet. Almost always the offer — the math changed in the shopper's head.
add_to_cart_to_checkout.recover: Abandoned-cart nudge with the shipping math spelled out.

checklist.detail: No testimonials, reviews, or security badges on the checkout step itself. This is where doubt peaks.
Too many steps or form fields, no guest checkout, forced account creation.
Slow checkout on mobile data kills completions silently — most Egyptian shoppers never touch desktop.
If courier failures are climbing, checkouts stall because shoppers have learned orders don't arrive. Check the delivery trend alongside this step.
No order confirmation on WhatsApp after purchase — shoppers in Egypt expect it, and its absence seeds doubt mid-checkout.

checkout_to_purchase.fix_cause: Fix the top-scoring item above, then re-measure this step for 7 days.
checkout_to_purchase.label: Checkout → Purchase
checkout_to_purchase.likely_meaning: They were ready to pay and something stopped them. Usually trust or friction at the finish line.
checkout_to_purchase.recover: WhatsApp nudge to checkout abandoners from the last 48h.

checklist.detail: Weak or too few product photos/video. For fashion: no try-on, no fabric close-up, no size reference on a real body.
No ratings or reviews visible without scrolling. Shoppers decide in seconds — social proof has to be instant.
Price hidden behind variants, no compare-at anchor, discount mechanics unclear on first view.
Low-intent sessions from broad targeting or mismatched creative. Check bounce by ad set — if one ad set's traffic never converts, it's the audience, not the page.
Dead or thin Instagram/TikTok makes first-time visitors bounce — they check your profile before they trust your store.

session_to_add_to_cart.fix_cause: Fix the top-scoring item above, then re-measure this step for 7 days.
session_to_add_to_cart.label: Sessions → Add to cart
session_to_add_to_cart.likely_meaning: They land, they don't bite. Usually the product page — or the traffic itself was never going to buy.
session_to_add_to_cart.recover: Retarget the bounced sessions with the product's best creative.
